properties.property: CREATE TABLE agent_session_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas ( sessionId String COMMENT '会话id', createTime DateTime COMMENT '创建时间', lastAccessTime DateTime COMMENT '最后访问时间', userId Nullable(String) COMMENT '用户id', agentId Nullable(String) COMMENT '代理id', title Nullable(String) COMMENT '会话标题', domain Nullable(String) COMMENT '会话所属领域' ) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/{table}', '{replica}') ORDER BY (sessionId)
drop TABLE agent_session_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC
CREATE TABLE agent_session on cluster vops_3shards_1replicas AS agent_session_local ENGINE = Distributed(vops_3shards_1replicas, currentDatabase(), agent_session_local, rand())
drop TABLE agent_session ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC

CREATE TABLE agent_session_message_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas ( msgId String COMMENT '消息id', parentMsgId Nullable(String) COMMENT '父消息id', nextMsgId Nullable(String) COMMENT '后序消息id，摘要消息时需指定，以便恢复状态时，能够将摘要消息放置到正确的位置（后序消息的前面）', createTime DateTime COMMENT '创建时间', sessionId String COMMENT '会话id', requestId Nullable(String) COMMENT '请求id', traceId Nullable(String) COMMENT 'trace id', parentAgentId Nullable(String) COMMENT '父智能体id', agentId Nullable(String) COMMENT '创建或者消息所属的agentid,如果节点类型是串行容器智能体节点（sequence）、并行容器智能体节点（parallel），对应创建消息的agentid为subAgentIdBy对应的值', agentNodeType Nullable(String) COMMENT '智能体节点类型：标准化智能体节点（standard）、串行容器智能体节点（sequence）、并行容器智能体节点（parallel）', subAgentIdBy Nullable(String) COMMENT '创建消息的子agentid，节点类型是串行容器智能体节点（sequence）、并行容器智能体节点（parallel）有值', messageType Nullable(String) COMMENT '0 代表子智能体辅助消息， 1 代表子智能体输出结果 2 代表用户输入消息 3 智能体系统消息 5 智能体跟踪消息 是否是agent的最终结果消息（messageType=1），需要加载到父agent的记忆消息中', seqNo Int32 COMMENT '消息序号', message Nullable(String) COMMENT '消息正文', groupId Nullable(String) COMMENT '消息分组id，隶属于并行分支中时，该字段有值', parentGroupId Nullable(String) COMMENT '消息父分组id，分组所在的并行分支隶属于父并行分支中时，该字段有值，为父并行节点的分组id', tokenMetrics Nullable(String) COMMENT 'token消耗统计', elapsed Int32 COMMENT '耗时', role Nullable(String) COMMENT '角色', marks Nullable(String) COMMENT '消息标记', metadata Nullable(String) COMMENT '消息元数据', name Nullable(String) COMMENT '消息名称' ) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/{table}', '{replica}') ORDER BY (sessionId, createTime,seqNo)
drop TABLE agent_session_message_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC

CREATE TABLE agent_session_message on cluster vops_3shards_1replicas AS agent_session_message_local ENGINE = Distributed(vops_3shards_1replicas, currentDatabase(), agent_session_message_local, sipHash64(sessionId))
drop TABLE agent_session_message ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC

CREATE TABLE agent_session_message_ref_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas ( msgId String COMMENT '消息id', msgAgentId String COMMENT '消息所属智能体agentId', refAgentId String COMMENT '引用消息智能体agentId', sessionId String COMMENT '会话id', requestId Nullable(String) COMMENT '请求id' ) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/{table}', '{replica}') ORDER BY (sessionId)
drop TABLE agent_session_message_ref_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC

CREATE TABLE agent_session_message_ref on cluster vops_3shards_1replicas AS agent_session_message_ref_local ENGINE = Distributed(vops_3shards_1replicas, currentDatabase(), agent_session_message_ref_local, sipHash64(sessionId))
drop TABLE agent_session_message_ref ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC

CREATE TABLE agent_memory_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas ( memoryId String COMMENT '记录id，主键', createTime DateTime COMMENT '创建时间', updateTime DateTime COMMENT '更新时间', agentId String COMMENT '智能体id', parentAgentId Nullable(String) COMMENT '父智能体id', userId String COMMENT '用户id', sessionId Nullable(String) COMMENT '会话id', content Nullable(String) COMMENT '总账记忆内容，一个智能体+用户一条记录' ) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/{table}', '{replica}') ORDER BY (agentId,userId)
drop TABLE agent_memory_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC
CREATE TABLE agent_memory ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas AS agent_memory_local ENGINE = Distributed(vops_3shards_1replicas, currentDatabase(), agent_memory_local, sipHash64(memoryId))
drop TABLE agent_memory ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC

CREATE TABLE agent_day_memory_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas ( memoryId String COMMENT '记录id，主键', createTime DateTime COMMENT '创建时间', updateTime DateTime COMMENT '更新时间', agentId String COMMENT '智能体id', parentAgentId Nullable(String) COMMENT '父智能体id', userId String COMMENT '用户id', sessionId Nullable(String) COMMENT '会话id', content Nullable(String) COMMENT '记忆内容，一个智能体+用户一天一条记录', memoryDay String COMMENT '记忆时间 yyyy-MM-dd' ) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/{table}', '{replica}') ORDER BY (agentId,userId,createTime)
drop TABLE agent_day_memory_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC
CREATE TABLE agent_day_memory ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas AS agent_day_memory_local ENGINE = Distributed(vops_3shards_1replicas, currentDatabase(), agent_day_memory_local, sipHash64(memoryId))
drop TABLE agent_day_memory ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC

CREATE TABLE agent_consolidation_state_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas ( consolidationStateId String COMMENT '记录id，主键', createTime DateTime COMMENT '创建时间', updateTime DateTime COMMENT '更新时间', agentId Nullable(String) COMMENT '智能体id', parentAgentId Nullable(String) COMMENT '父智能体id', userId Nullable(String) COMMENT '用户id', consolidationState varchar(100) COMMENT '水位日期时间，例如：2026-10-08T14:47:45.570362Z' ) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/{table}', '{replica}') ORDER BY (consolidationStateId)
drop TABLE agent_consolidation_state_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC

CREATE TABLE agent_consolidation_state ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas AS agent_consolidation_state_local ENGINE = Distributed(vops_3shards_1replicas, currentDatabase(), agent_consolidation_state_local, sipHash64(consolidationStateId))
drop TABLE agent_consolidation_state ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC

CREATE TABLE agent_hitl_calltask_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas ( hitlTaskId String COMMENT '人工介入任务id', traceId Nullable(String) COMMENT 'trace id', agentId Nullable(String) COMMENT '智能体id', agentName Nullable(String) COMMENT '智能体名称', parentAgentId Nullable(String) COMMENT '父智能体id', parentAgentName Nullable(String) COMMENT '父智能体名称', sessionId String COMMENT '会话id', requestId Nullable(String) COMMENT '请求id', userId Nullable(String) COMMENT '用户id', hitlTaskReason Nullable(String) COMMENT '人工介入任务内容，LLM生成', hitlTaskData Nullable(String) COMMENT '人工介入任务内容，人工辅助提供', exception Nullable(String) COMMENT '异常信息', hitlTaskStatus Nullable(Int32) COMMENT '人工介入任务状态：0 待处理 1 已处理 2 已拒绝 3 超时忽略 5 已结束', hitlTaskHandleResult Nullable(String) COMMENT '人工介入任务处理结果说明', hitlTaskCreateTime Nullable(DateTime) COMMENT '人工介入任务创建时间', hitlTaskHandleTime Nullable(DateTime) COMMENT '人工介入任务处理时间', hitlTaskCompleteTime Nullable(DateTime) COMMENT '人工介入任务完成时间' ) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/{table}', '{replica}') ORDER BY (hitlTaskId)
drop TABLE agent_hitl_calltask_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC

CREATE TABLE agent_hitl_calltask ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas AS agent_hitl_calltask_local ENGINE = Distributed(vops_3shards_1replicas, currentDatabase(), agent_hitl_calltask_local, sipHash64(sessionId))
drop TABLE agent_hitl_calltask ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC

CREATE TABLE agent_tool_call_rules_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas ( agentToolCallRulesId String COMMENT '存储用户调用工具的权限规则id', createTime DateTime COMMENT '创建时间', updateTime DateTime COMMENT '更新时间', userId Nullable(String) COMMENT '用户id', sessionId String COMMENT '调用工具的会话id', toolName String COMMENT '工具名称', agentId String COMMENT '调用工具的智能体id', permissionRules String COMMENT '工具调用权限规则：允许调用工具的权限规则,拒绝调用工具的权限规则，需要用户确认的权限规则' ) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/{database}/{table}', '{replica}') ORDER BY (agentToolCallRulesId)
drop TABLE agent_tool_call_rules_local ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC

CREATE TABLE agent_tool_call_rules ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas AS agent_tool_call_rules_local ENGINE = Distributed(vops_3shards_1replicas, currentDatabase(), agent_tool_call_rules_local, sipHash64(sessionId))
drop TABLE agent_tool_call_rules ON CLUSTER vops_3shards_1replicas SYNC
